intent: Count catalogue product variants whose product kind is 'Nut Bolt and Washer'.
success_criteria: Single integer count of product_variants joined to product_kinds where product_kind_name = 'Nut Bolt and Washer'
Answer rendered exactly as %d (bare integer, no quotes)

args.stdin: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_kinds pk ON pv.product_kind_id = pk.product_kind_id WHERE pk.product_kind_name = :kind_name;
